name.en: Gymnasiale Matura (entering work with Matura only)
name.fr: Maturité gymnasiale (entrée dans la vie active avec la maturité)
name.it: Maturità liceale (ingresso nel lavoro con la sola maturità)

pathway.label: Gymnasiale Maturität
pathway.note: berufsberatung.ch states 3–6 years depending on canton (partly overlapping compulsory school); 4 years after compulsory school assumed.

entryAccess.note: Admission by school grades or entrance exam, depending on canton.

mobility.note: General school-leaving certificate; widely recognised for study access, not as a vocational qualification.

meta.notes: Mainly a gateway to university; scored here as a terminal qualification for comparison. LSE pools Gymnasiale and Berufsmaturität.
